_note: get_strategy_column_contract responses, VERBATIM. Each case pairs the exact request sent with the exact result returned. Nothing normalised, reordered or repaired - including the platform's own defective formula text for the chained spread->trajectory case, which is preserved as-is and annotated in composition_rules.chaining.knownDocDefect. Read-only capture: this tool reads no market values and consumes no quota.

contract.calculationSummary: Select one value at the requested offset.
contract.nullBehavior: Returns null when the requested slot is absent or the source value is null.

contract.calculationSummary: Measure the signed percentage gap between the base and one operand metric. Render the recent build-up plus its rising, falling, or flat direction.
contract.formula: output = (EMA5 - EMA13) / EMA13 × 100; slots = last 4 non-null EMA5 values; trend = compare(first, last)

glossary.EMA5_EMA13_spread_t3: EMA5_EMA13_spread: % gap EMA5 vs EMA13. 4-period trajectory (t3 → … → now); EMA5_EMA13_spread_trend = direction over the window.
glossary.EMA5_EMA13_spread_t2: EMA5_EMA13_spread: % gap EMA5 vs EMA13. 4-period trajectory (t3 → … → now); EMA5_EMA13_spread_trend = direction over the window.
glossary.EMA5_EMA13_spread_t1: EMA5_EMA13_spread: % gap EMA5 vs EMA13. 4-period trajectory (t3 → … → now); EMA5_EMA13_spread_trend = direction over the window.
glossary.EMA5_EMA13_spread_now: EMA5_EMA13_spread: % gap EMA5 vs EMA13. 4-period trajectory (t3 → … → now); EMA5_EMA13_spread_trend = direction over the window.
glossary.EMA5_EMA13_spread_trend: EMA5_EMA13_spread: % gap EMA5 vs EMA13. 4-period trajectory (t3 → … → now); EMA5_EMA13_spread_trend = direction over the window.

contract.nullBehavior: Returns null when either operand is null or the second operand is zero. Missing observations produce null slots; an empty series has null now and trend.

contract.calculationSummary: Render the recent build-up plus its rising, falling, or flat direction.
contract.formula: slots = last 4 non-null CCI values; trend = compare(first, last)

glossary.CCI_t3: 4-period trajectory (t3 → … → now); CCI_trend = direction over the window.
glossary.CCI_t2: 4-period trajectory (t3 → … → now); CCI_trend = direction over the window.
glossary.CCI_t1: 4-period trajectory (t3 → … → now); CCI_trend = direction over the window.
glossary.CCI_now: 4-period trajectory (t3 → … → now); CCI_trend = direction over the window.
glossary.CCI_trend: 4-period trajectory (t3 → … → now); CCI_trend = direction over the window.

contract.nullBehavior: Missing observations produce null slots; an empty series has null now and trend.

outputs.meaning: dist_VWAP: % from current price to VWAP. dist_VWAP_rank_hi: ordinal across the tracked universe, 1 = highest value, rendered as rank/universe-size; the standing as of the last close, unchanged until the next one.

contract.calculationSummary: Measure signed percentage distance from current price to a price-level metric. Read the platform-computed ordinal for the base metric across the tracked universe. The ranked set holds current values only, so there is no historical ordinal to offset into.
contract.formula: output = ((price - VWAP) / VWAP) × 100; output = ordinal(VWAP among the ranked universe, by the chosen ordering)

glossary.dist_VWAP_rank_hi: dist_VWAP: % from current price to VWAP. dist_VWAP_rank_hi: ordinal across the tracked universe, 1 = highest value, rendered as rank/universe-size; the standing as of the last close, unchanged until the next one.

contract.nullBehavior: Returns null when price or the base level is null, or when the base level is zero. Returns null when the ranked universe carries no entry for the asset.
